# Teleskope

> > Teleskope is an integrated employee experience platform combining ERG management, mentoring, events, and employee journey automation for enterprise organizations.

Teleskope provides a comprehensive suite of software solutions designed to enhance employee engagement, diversity, and inclusion through connected modules. The platform serves Fortune 500 companies with integrated tools for managing employee resource groups, mentoring programs, internal communications, and employee lifecycle journeys.

## Key Topics

- ERG Management
- Mentoring Software
- Employee Experience
- Talent Peak
- Office Raven
- People Hero
- Teleskope Affinities
- Event Management
- Internal Communications
- Employee Engagement
- HR Automation
- Matching Algorithms
- Program Management
- Employee Communities
- Enterprise SaaS

## Core Platform & Products

- [Teleskope Platform Overview](https://www.teleskope.io): Leading platform for ERG management, mentoring, events, and employee experience
- [Teleskope Affinities - ERG Management Software](https://www.teleskope.io/products/erg-management-software): ERG management and employee community platform for employee resource groups
- [Talent Peak - Mentoring Software](https://www.teleskope.io/products/mentoring-software): Enterprise mentoring software with smart matching algorithms trusted by Fortune 500 companies
- [Office Raven - Employee Events & Communications](https://www.teleskope.io/products/employee-events-communications-software): Events and internal communications platform for enterprises
- [People Hero - Employee Journey Software](https://www.teleskope.io/products/employee-journey-software): Employee journey and onboarding automation platform

## ERG & Community Management

- [ERG Management Software](https://www.teleskope.io/employee-resource-group-management): ERG management with membership tracking, events, and budget management

## Mentoring & Development

- [Mentoring Programs](https://www.teleskope.io/mentoring): Talent Peak mentoring program management and measurement platform
- [Volunteering Programs](https://www.teleskope.io/volunteering): Employee volunteering program management and tracking solution

## Events & Communications

- [Office Events Management](https://www.teleskope.io/officeevents): Office Raven: Office event management with RSVP and attendance tracking
- [Internal Communications](https://www.teleskope.io/internalcommunications): Office Raven: Internal communications with approval workflows and analytics

## Employee Lifecycle & HR Automation

- [Employee Journeys](https://www.teleskope.io/employeejourneys): People Hero: Employee lifecycle and journey automation at scale
- [Meeting Scheduling & HR Automation](https://www.teleskope.io/meetingscheduling): People Hero: Meeting scheduling and HR automation for employee lifecycle
- [Frontline Employee Engagement](https://www.teleskope.io/frontlineengagement): Frontline employee engagement with mobile app for iOS and Android
